# Common sink parameters

This reference lists the parameters that all event sink types share. Define these parameters in the `sink` block, alongside the sink-specific parameters for a [`file`](/boundary/docs/monitor/events/file) or [`stderr`](/boundary/docs/monitor/events/stderr) sink. For configuration instructions, refer to [Configure event sinks](/boundary/docs/monitor/events/configure-sinks).

```hcl
sink {
  name        = "obs-sink"
  description = "Observations sent to a file"
  event_types = ["observation"]
  format      = "cloudevents-json"
  audit_config {
    audit_filter_overrides {
      sensitive = "redact"
      secret    = "redact"
    }
  }
}
```

## Parameters

- `name` `(string: <required>)` - Specifies a name for the sink.

- `description` `(string: "")` - Specifies a description for the sink.

- `type` `(string: <required>)` - Specifies the type of sink. Can be `stderr` or `file`. If you label the `sink` block, for example `sink "stderr"`, Boundary uses the label as the type. If you nest a `file` or `stderr` block inside the sink, Boundary infers the type from the block.

- `event_types` `(array(string): <required>)` - Specifies the event types that Boundary sends to the sink. Can be `*`, `audit`, `error`, `observation`, `system`, or `telemetry`. If you include `telemetry`, you must also include `observation`.

- `format` `(string: <required>)` - Specifies the format of the events that Boundary writes to the sink. Can be `cloudevents-json`, `cloudevents-text`, `hclog-json`, or `hclog-text`.

- `event_source_url` `(string: "")` - Specifies the event source URL for the sink. If not specified, Boundary composes the source from `https://hashicorp.com/boundary.io/ServerName/Path/FileName`.

- `allow_filters` `(array(string): [])` - Specifies a set of predicates for including an event in the sink. If any filter matches, Boundary includes the event. Refer to [Filter events](/boundary/docs/monitor/events/filter-events).

- `deny_filters` `(array(string): [])` - Specifies a set of predicates for excluding an event from the sink. If any filter matches, Boundary excludes the event. Refer to [Filter events](/boundary/docs/monitor/events/filter-events).

- `audit_config` `(block: optional)` - Specifies how Boundary processes audit events for the sink. Boundary ignores this block if the sink does not receive `audit` events.

  - `audit_filter_overrides` `(block: optional)` - Specifies overrides for the filter operations applied to audit events.

    - `sensitive` `(string: "redact")` - Specifies the filter operation to apply to fields that Boundary classifies as sensitive. Can be `""`, `encrypt`, `hmac-sha256`, or `redact`. An empty string applies no filter.

    - `secret` `(string: "redact")` - Specifies the filter operation to apply to fields that Boundary classifies as secret. Can be `""`, `encrypt`, `hmac-sha256`, or `redact`. An empty string applies no filter.
